comments.text: Sweden is a fantastic country with a lot to offer international tourists, to see and experience. Recommended! Varied Swedish music and Swedish artists such as accordion music, rock carvings, ancient remains, archipelagos with islands, nature reserves, amusement parks, good Swedish home cooking such as varied food and much more. Some old famous Swedish musicians and artists, but who are no longer alive, are Povel Ramel, Thore Skogman, Stefan Demert, Fredrik Åkerström and Cornelis Vreeswijk and many more. But personally, I prefer listening to Balochi music the most, as well as international world music with various artists in different languages more than Swedish and English music. Greetings from Christian Svensson, Sweden. PS. Balochi music has a great and rich variety of different mixed instruments such as different flutes and string instruments, known for its traditional culture with lovely sounds and beautiful music styles and genres. Recommended! 👋☺💕💕👋😀❤❤
